latestVersion.changelog:
AI Music Generator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generate music-backed videos using AI, with support for MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Simple onboarding: automatic backend connection, free token generation, and session setup for new users.
- Cloud processing pipeline delivers 1080p music-synced videos ready to download in under 90 seconds.
- All key actions (upload, edit, export, credits, status) classified via prompt analysis and routed to dedicated endpoints.
- Plain-language instructions with detailed feedback, error handling, and workflow tips for creators.
- Session state and timeline editing supported for iterative, batch, and quick edits.
